changelog:
- Initial release of conqueror-seo-project-setup skill: guides users through the foundational setup for a durable local SEO workspace.
- Structured workflow to gather project folder, website scope, goals, positioning/context, MCP verification, and Search Console access.
- Provides clear, beginner-friendly guidance on each step with practical tips and folder structure suggestions.
- Includes a progress checklist/table and summarizes key project setup details.
- Recommends an appropriate next workflow based on intake.
- Built-in guardrails to keep setup lightweight and accurate; avoids jargon and premature research unless user requests it.
summary: Set up a durable local SEO workspace: working folder, site scope, goals, positioning, MCP and project check, and Search Console intake. Use at the start of a new SEO project. Requires a connected Conqueror MCP server.
